purpose.zh: 练臀部和肩部，打开胸口
purpose.en: Build the glutes and shoulders and open the chest.

text.zh: 手和脚跟推地，把髋抬到肩、髋、膝一平
text.en: Push through your hands and heels and lift your hips level with shoulders and knees
Point your fingers toward your feet and keep your arms straight.

text.zh: 胸口打开，肩胛向中间收
text.en: Open your chest and draw your shoulder blades together.

commonErrors.en: Not lifting the hips high enough.

cautions.zh: 先做手腕热身；手腕刺痛或发麻就停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first, and stop if they feel sharp pain or numbness.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.
